subject: Premortem: final go/no-go checklist, signer windows, and day-one ramp
messages:
From: Lena Morris <lena@brightretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightretail.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: final timeline and signers for Redwood pilot

Mina —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and legal asked me to lock timelines so we can align exec sign-off with our leadership meeting on June 14. High-level asks: can we get an agreed MAP and SOW by end of day Friday (June 4) so internal reviews start, and signatures in DocuSign by June 11?

Specifics we need from you:
- Final SOW (version with pricing and start date)
- MAP milestones and owner names for the evaluation (who's owning infra, test prompts, metrics)
- Confirmation of earliest start date (we'd like June 21 as a target)

We've looped in Procurement and Tim from Legal (cc). Let us know if any of those dates are unrealistic from your side — we have a narrow window.

Best,
Lena Morris
Head of Partnerships
BrightRetail Inc.

Attachments: none
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morris <lena@brightretail.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: final timeline and signers for Redwood pilot

Hi Lena —

Thanks — this is doable but tight. Quick responses below and I attached the MAP workbook and SOW v3 with the proposed start date and signer block.

High level:
- We will deliver the redline-ready SOW and MAP by EOD Thu (June 3) to give your teams one business day to route (you asked for EOD Fri; we can aim sooner).
- DocuSign signature plan: we can queue CC signing for June 9–11. That lets us close before your June 14 leadership meeting and preserves June 21 onboarding target.
- Earliest deterministic start: June 21 (we'll reserve a slot in our onboarding queue; final slot confirmed once SOW countersigned).

Owner matrix (from MAP sheet):
- BrightRetail: Lena (exec sponsor), Mike Patel (integration lead), Procurement (contract).
- Redwood: Mina (deal lead), Kimberly Park (legal ops escalation), Rishi Malhotra (customer success / onboarding), Jordan Blake (solutions lead).

Open items we need from you by Thu EOD:
1) Procurement point-of-contact for Esign routing (name + email).
2) Any non-standard legal terms we should expect (data retention, audit windows).
3) Confirmation of the primary evaluation metric (latency 95th, false positives on reranking, or business KPI?).

I'll follow up internally to confirm the DocuSign template and signer order.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_BrightRetail_v2.xlsx, BrightRetail_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tim Choi <tim.choi@brightretail.com>, procurement@brightretail.com, Lena Morris <lena@brightretail.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOW & MAP — quick legal note on billing term and audit

Tim / Procurement —

Forwarding SOW v3 with two narrow redlines we anticipate: one around billing cadence (we proposed monthly in arrears) and one around audit access for SOC2 evidence. Both are negotiable but we wanted to surface them before your review so you can flag any absolute blockers.

I also put a DOCTYPE block in the DocuSign plan so we can swap signer order if needed. If procurement can confirm signer order by Thu noon (June 3), we will prep DocuSign envelopes for a June 9 send.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Legal Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redlines_BrightRetail_SOW.docx (summary of proposed changes)
From: Tim Choi <tim.choi@brightretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightretail.com, lena@brightretail.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOW & MAP — quick legal note on billing term and audit

Kimberly / Mina —

Appreciate the heads up. Procurement confirms the signer order: CFO (Roberta Lane) -> Head of Ops (Lena Morris) -> CTO (Elliot Shaw). Roberta's assistant (procurement@brightretail.com) will be the envelope manager.

On redlines:
- Billing cadence: prefer net 30 from invoice date — willing to accept monthly in arrears if we get a 45-day invoice acceptance window.
- Audit: require read-only access to relevant logs for the evaluation period only; no broader compliance obligation.

We'll upload our suggested language later today; look out for a short redline doc.

Thanks,
Tim Choi
Senior Counsel, BrightRetail Inc.

Attachments: none (redline coming in separate email)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morris <lena@brightretail.com>, procurement@brightretail.com, tim.choi@brightretail.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: DocuSign queue, cutover checklist, and day-one onboarding slot (confirmed)

Team —

Status update and final plan following internal reviews and your redlines:

1) SOW & redlines: We incorporated your audit language (read-only logs for evaluation period) and accepted the billing cadence compromise. Final SOW v4 is attached and has been uploaded to the HubSpot deal record.

2) DocuSign & signer windows: Per Tim, signer order will be Roberta Lane -> Lena Morris -> Elliot Shaw. Procurement (procurement@brightretail.com) has been added as envelope manager. We will send the DocuSign envelope on Wednesday June 9 at 09:00 PST to maximize overlap with your approvers. Target completion window: June 9–11. Please confirm Roberta's assistant can click the final approval on June 10 if needed.

3) MAP milestones and owners: MAP_BrightRetail_v2.xlsx contains milestone dates. Key early checkpoints:
   - Week 0 (June 21): Provisioning and secured VPC + sample dataset ingestion (owner: Jordan Blake).
   - Week 1: Eval run 1 — throughput & latency baselines (owner: Rishi Malhotra).
   - Week 3: Quality review & regression check against Golden Prompts (owner: Mina Haddad).

4) Onboarding slot reserved: We have tentatively reserved the June 21 onboarding slot. This is held for 72 hours pending signed SOW. If countersign occurs after June 12, the next available slot is July 5.

5) Next steps (action items):
- BrightRetail: confirm Roberta's assistant ok to sign on June 10 (procurement@brightretail.com) — due Tue June 8 EOD.
- Redwood: prep DocuSign envelope (Mina/Kimberly) and hold onboarding runbook & engineer time.
- Both: final handoff call scheduled June 10 at 10:00 AM PT to validate the SOW & kickoff logistics. Invite sent.

If all good, we will hit the DocuSign send on June 9 and aim to start provisioning June 21. Thank you for the efficient turnaround — appreciate the team's coordination.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightRetail_SOW_v4.pdf, MAP_BrightRetail_v2.xlsx
